room: a bright empty stretching room with lilac walls, a light wooden floor, a pink yoga mat on the floor, rolled exercise mats and a foam roller against the wall, a pink dumbbell, a tall leaning mirror and sheer curtains by a large window

scenes.name: M2_mat_stand
scenes.action: standing on the pink yoga mat with only her left hand on her hip, her right arm hanging straight down
scenes.anchor: the rolled mats against the wall reach her waist

scenes.name: M2_mat_crouch
scenes.action: crouching low on the pink yoga mat, her forearms resting on her knees
scenes.anchor: crouched, her head is about as high as the top of the rolled mats behind her

scenes.name: M2_mat_lie
scenes.action: lying on her back on the pink yoga mat with her knees slightly bent, her head towards the mirror
scenes.anchor: the yoga mat is about as long as she is

scenes.name: M2_mirror_face
scenes.action: standing in front of the tall leaning mirror, her right hand touching her right cheek, her left arm relaxed at her side
scenes.anchor: the top of the leaning mirror is above her head
